MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Live streaming Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Live streaming Project.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Live streaming Project.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Live streaming Project.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Live streaming Project.

2. When learning Fundamentals of Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Media Technology.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Media Technology.

3. When learning Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fundamentals of Emerging Media Technology 1.2 Pre-production 1.3 Production 1.4 .

4. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.

5. When learning Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

7. When learning Photography: technology and techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography: technology and techniques.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography: technology and techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Photography: technology and techniques.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography: technology and techniques.

8. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

9. When learning Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Med.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Pre- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre- production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre- production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre- production.

12. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Post-production 1.5 Project Activity 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography: techn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Post- production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Live streaming Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
